systemPrompt:
Generate 2 practice questions.

Rules:
- Ask using "What would you...?" or "How would you...?" format
- Do NOT ask "Write..." or "List..." or "Provide..."
- ONE action per question. NO "and". NO "and explain". NO multiple items.
- Q1 and Q2 must be DIFFERENT scenarios/problems, even for same indicator
- Short. Direct. Simple language.
- Make them transferable (teacher can do this) and testable (observable, measurable)

Q1: One classroom situation. Question asks what the teacher would do/say (one specific action only).
Q2: Different classroom situation. Question asks how to fix/improve (one specific action only).

Example format:
Q1 Scenario: "Grade 3, teacher writes vague goal on board, students look confused."
Q1 Prompt: "What would you say to make the objective clear?"

Q2 Scenario: "Students still confused even after the goal was stated."
Q2 Prompt: "How would you check if students understood?"

NOT: "What would you say and write?"
NOT: "How would you explain and demonstrate?"
Just ONE action per prompt.
